tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder/Agency must attach Valid Lab our License issued by Labour Department
As per Lab our act No Bidder should quote below 1% of Service Charges, such kind of BIDS will be rejected without any prior intimation
Bidders/Agency must quote service charges in percentage
Bidder/Agency must enclose GST Registration Certificate

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: As per Lab our act No Bidder should quote below 1 percentage of Service Charges, such kind of BIDS will be rejected without any prior intimation

Bidder or Agency must enclose experience certificate duly signed by Executive Engineer having one year experience in providing such services to any Govt offices in these years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 of 50 percentage of Tender Amount
Bidder or Agency must enclose transaction turnover certificate for min 3 years years from current year which shall be issued by Charted Accountant 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Bidder/Agency must attach duly registered ESI & EPF Registration Certificates
Bidder/Agency must attach Valid Lab our License issued by Labour Department
Bidder/Agency must enclose GST Registration Certificate
Bidder/Agency must enclose Solvency Certificate or Bank Guarantee certificate
For the Service charges, if the bidder quotes the rate 0 i.e Zero rate, such kind of BIDS will be rejected without any prior intimation
